evals.prompt: I'm launching a company called Tidewater — we build autonomous underwater drones that inspect offshore wind-farm foundations and export cables. Buyers are marine-operations managers at energy utilities; the feel should be serious maritime engineering, not a gadget startup. No website yet, just this description. Create the complete brand kit — logo, wordmark, lockups, icons, favicon, guidelines, everything — as vector assets that work on light and dark backgrounds.
evals.expected_output: A packaged brand-kit folder: svg/ subfolders (mark, wordmark, lockup, icon, themed) with dark/light/mono logomark variants, an outlined (not live-text) wordmark, baseline-aligned lockups, round-safe avatar + adaptive icons, a self-theming favicon, PNG rasters, a README with usage rules and honest limitations, and a generated guidelines.html. Process evidence of adversarial review (concepts critiqued/scored, not first-idea-shipped).
assertions: Kit is packaged: a brand-kit folder exists containing organised svg subfolders (mark, wordmark, lockup, icon or equivalent), a README, and a guidelines HTML page
Logomark ships in both dark-ground and light-ground colourways AND at least one single-colour (mono) variant
All shipped SVGs are pure vector: no <image> elements, no <filter>/feGaussianBlur, and marks contain no live <text>
Every shipped SVG has a viewBox plus explicit width and height attributes (survives Office/Slides import and bare use)
Wordmark is real outlines: contains <path> data for the letterforms and no <text>/<tspan> elements
Round-safe icons exist: a dedicated avatar and/or adaptive-icon variant whose artwork is scaled visibly smaller in-frame than the square icon (ink fits a circular mask), not just a copy
Favicon strategy handles both tab themes: either one SVG embedding a prefers-color-scheme style block, or explicit dark+light favicon files
PNG rasters are included at more than one size (e.g. favicon sizes and at least one large export)
README (or guidelines) states usage rules including a light/dark or circular-mask caveat, and an honest known-limitations section
Adversarial process ran: working files show multiple concepts with critique/scoring evidence (kill/rework verdicts, judge scores, or law audits) — not a single first idea shipped
Render-and-look evidence: PNG previews/contact sheets of candidate marks exist among the working files
The guidelines HTML is self-contained: no http(s):// references to external scripts, stylesheets, or fonts
